data.long_meaning: The meaning of Quint is recorded in name-lists as “Fifth”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quint expresses “Fifth”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quint total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: החמצון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Quint is derived from the Hebrew word חמצון (hachamtson), which means 'the fifth'. This name is not explicitly mentioned in the Bible, but it can be inferred from the use of the number five in various biblical contexts.

in_greek.name: πέντη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Quint is derived from the Greek word πέντη (pentē), which means 'five'. This name is not explicitly mentioned in the New Testament, but it can be found in various Greek texts and inscriptions related to the Bible.

in_latin.name: Quintus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Quint is derived from the Latin word Quintus, which means 'fifth'. This name is not explicitly mentioned in the Latin Vulgate Bible, but it can be found in various Latin texts and inscriptions related to the Bible.
